payload.summary: Section 2 of the 2026/27 budget report: the General Fund budget and the medium-term financial strategy. It sets a net budget requirement of £24.25m, recommends a 2.99% council tax rise taking Band D to £315.26, states the prudent minimum general reserve as £5,500,000 against a balance expected to stay at £8,249,000, and prints the full consultation result in Appendix 2(F) — including the questions where residents disagreed with the council.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
